summary: Datavault AI Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a letter agreement with EOS Technology Holdings Inc. (formerly Data Vault Holdings) amending the December 31, 2024 Earnout Agreement. EOS Holdings may elect, at its sole discretion, to receive earnout payments in common stock instead of cash, at a fixed price of $0.61 per share for the period ended December 31, 2025, or the 5-day VWAP for later periods. Issuance is capped at 19.99% of outstanding shares unless stockholder approval is obtained, with excess paid in cash. This is a contractual modification of earnout consideration, not a standard special situation; watch for subsequent issuance notices and potential dilution.
